release_notes: Fixed Anime Revival Extractor v1.0.4: Abyss and Blogger streams now play
Added KReanime Extractor v1.0.0 with rotating FlixCloud WASM decryption and multi-server HLS streaming
Added KAnimeHeaven Extractor v1.0.1 with direct MP4 streaming and soft-subtitle control
Updated KOpenSubtitle to v1.0.4 with exact MAL/AniList ID, episode air-date, and streaming-cut matching

plugins.name: KAnikoto Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Official online streaming plugin for Anikoto with MegaPlay AES decryption and multi-server HLS streams.
changelog: Faster search matching and MegaPlay AES decryption

plugins.name: KReanime Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: High-speed anime streaming plugin for ReAnime with rotating WASM-based FlixCloud AES-256 decryption and multi-server HLS streams.
changelog: Pure Kotlin WASM bytecode decryptor & AES-256-CBC engine with local manifest decrypt proxy
Multi-server HD-1, HD-2, H-SUB sub & dub streams with full soft-subtitles

plugins.name: KAnimeHeaven Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Direct high-speed MP4 anime streaming plugin for AnimeHeaven with session-aware gate extraction.
changelog: Fixed subtitle track metadata so turning off subtitles in the player hides captions cleanly
Improved session-aware MP4 gate extraction reliability

plugins.name: KOpenSubtitle
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Precision online subtitle provider using OpenSubtitles with exact MAL/AniList ID & episode matching.
changelog: Added exact MAL/AniList/Kitsu -> IMDb + season mapping via ARM
Added air-date, episode-title, split-cour Part 2, and absolute episode matching
Prioritized Crunchyroll/SubsPlease/Erai/WEB-DL releases over Netflix/BluRay cuts with release labels

plugins.name: Anime Revival Extractor
plugins.author: Anime Revival
plugins.description: Tagalog-dubbed anime streaming plugin for Anime Revival with reliable Blogger, Abyss CDN, and Archive.org playback through a built-in local stream proxy.
changelog: Fixed Blogger streams not playing: links are now verified and downloaded through a local stream proxy
Fixed Abyss streams not playing: chunked and multi-part video layouts are now rebuilt into one seekable MP4
Added automatic retries and short-term caching to fix random 'not found' errors
Streams are checked for real video data and expired links are refreshed automatically
